tellings.difference: Describes it as chrome-plated rather than copper, puts it years after childhood and suggests it was an implant.
tellings.link_reason: The same small metal ball, described as a BB, that came out of the witness's nose, now framed as a possible implant.

as_told.title: Chrome-plated BB-like object spat out of nose, possibly an implant

plain: Richard Barth is a man who says he once guarded nuclear missiles and was taken by aliens. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says that some years after 1964 he had a sinus problem, blew his nose, and a BB came out. A BB is a small metal pellet, like the ones fired from air guns. He describes it as a little round ball with one flat side. A researcher on the same show adds that it was not copper like a normal BB, but looked chrome plated. That speaker places it years after Barth's childhood and suggests it was an implant, an object put into his body. If true, it would be physical evidence left behind by whoever took him. So the story comes from Barth as a witness, with a researcher repeating and interpreting it.
